summary.headline: Broad risk-on session: crypto-adjacent names (COIN +9.5%, HOOD +7.2%) surge on CLARITY Act Senate momentum, resolving HOOD's regulatory-risk AMBER to green; AMD +8.1% on the Microsoft Azure Helios deployment deal into today's Advancing AI 2026 event; AI-chip/data-center names (MRVL, FCX, TSM, CRDO, LRCX) rally in sympathy ahead of GOOG's Q2 print after today's close -- the season's first hyperscaler-capex read. Meanwhile dividend-sleeve defensives rotated lower: GPC fell despite a Q2 beat on cautious H2 guidance citing Iran-conflict cost pressure (new AMBER, thesis-linked), ADP -3.6% with no same-day catalyst confirmed by a tier-1 source (new AMBER), and ATAT hit a fresh 52-week low (new AMBER). The US-Iran conflict remains the one portfolio-level RED -- not de-escalating, Brent near $92 with Trump threatening broader strikes. CWAN roster-integrity flag unresolved for a 28th day.

flags.headline: US-Iran conflict continues to escalate, not de-escalate -- Trump cools prospects for talks, threatens broader strikes; Brent near $92, a fourth straight day of gains
flags.detail: No de-escalation overnight. Bloomberg (07-21) reports Trump playing down near-term talks with Iran while threatening broader strikes, including reiterated threats to hit the suspected Iranian nuclear site at Pickaxe Mountain and a warning to respond if Houthi rebels disrupt Red Sea shipping -- supply-risk contagion spreading beyond the Gulf toward the Black Sea. Brent rose to trade around $92/bbl, a fourth consecutive day of gains, WTI above $85; oil is up roughly 20% this month. SPY is up +0.81% overnight per the data drop -- equities continue to read this as contained, but the risk stays asymmetric and unresolved. Continuing tailwind for the energy sleeve (VLO, CVX, OKE, DVN, CNX -- 5 of 52 holdings) and a standing geopolitical overhang for broader risk sentiment.
flags.thesis_link: Bears on CVX/VLO/OKE/DVN/CNX crude-price sensitivity (tailwind, not a threat, in current form). Persisting since 2026-07-19.

evidence.source: Bloomberg -- Oil Edges Higher as Trump Cools Prospects for Talks With Iran
